title: Would I be entitled to salary from Pinnacle Blooms Network?
metaTitle: Ownership Role Clarification - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Understanding the role and responsibilities of becoming a facility owner with Pinnacle Blooms Network, a leading provider of therapies for kids with sensorial conditions.
html: Skinvesting in a Pinnacle Blooms Network facility means taking on the role of an owner, not an employee. While you'll be leading the growth of your facility and the implementation of our therapies that's changing lives for better, the role encompasses ownership profits and responsibilities rather than a salaried position.
